name: Coral Alfalfa
headline: Coral Alfalfa
description: A natural plant source of minerals, vitamins, essential amino acids and phytoestrogens. It has a general tonic effect on the body and helps raise vitality; combining alfalfa powder with its concentrated juice strengthens the overall effect.
howToUse: Adults – 2 capsules twice a day with food.

manufacturing.expiration: 2 years from the date of manufacture
manufacturing.storage: Store in a dry place, protected from direct sunlight, out of reach of children, at a temperature not above +25°C.
manufacturing.ingredients: Concentrated alfalfa grass juice, alfalfa grass, calcium carbonate, excipients.
